title: SAL-SRL-16 Serial Registration Reg
summary: Ledgerline screen for registering and querying frame and battery pack serial numbers for warranty validation.
body:
Screen SAL-SRL-16 is the Ledgerline interface used to record and verify serial registration details for frame and battery pack components [^r1][^r7]. It establishes the registration status necessary to validate customer warranty claims [^r1]. Access is restricted to users assigned to the roles SAL-EXEC, SAL-MGR, or SYS-ADMIN [^r7].

| Field | Detail |
|---|---|
| Screen Code | SAL-SRL-16 [^r2][^r7] |
| Screen Title | SERIAL REGISTRATION REG [^r7] |
| Menu Path | Sales > Serial registration [^r7] |
| Allowed Roles | SAL-EXEC, SAL-MGR, SYS-ADMIN [^r7] |
| Primary Services | [[services-sal-srl|srl_search]], [[services-sal-srl|srl_get]], [[services-sal-srl|srl_reg]] [^r4][^r8][^r9][^r10][^r11] |

## Fields

* **SERIAL NO** (`serial_no`): Mandatory serial identifier for the frame or battery pack [^r2][^r7].
* **ITEM CD** (`itm_cd`): Mandatory inventory item code [^r2][^r7].
* **CUST CD** (`cust_cd`): Optional customer account code [^r2][^r7]. When processing large dispatch batches for a single bike shop, this field retains its value if the operator applies the standard terminal reset key instead of closing the screen [^r5].
* **SOLD DT** (`sold_dt`): Optional sale date [^r2][^r7]. If left blank during entry, Ledgerline populates it automatically with the current system working date [^r3].
* **STATUS** (`status`): Optional status field [^r2][^r7].

## Keys and services

* **Search (F2/Enter)**: Executes service `srl_search` (SERIAL REGISTRATION LIST) via endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/srl_search` to list serial registrations [^r4][^r8][^r11].
* **Get (F3)**: Executes read service `srl_get` (SERIAL REGISTRATION GET) to retrieve serial registration details by `serial_no` [^r4][^r8][^r9].
* **Reg**: Executes write service `srl_reg` (SERIAL REGISTRATION REG) via endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/srl_reg` to register new serial numbers [^r4][^r8][^r10].

Operators must not trigger `srl_reg` to amend an existing dispatch date or customer code; returned bicycles require goods inward credit handling procedures prior to making changes [^r6].

## Messages

* [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011]]: ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE [^r8].
* [[err-srl-0001|ERR-SRL-0001]]: Serial Number Already Registered [^r8].

## See also

* [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011 ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE]]
* [[err-srl-0001|ERR-SRL-0001 Serial Number Already Registered]]
* [[services-sal-srl|SAL srl services]]

r1.quote: The serial must be registered (SAL-SRL-16) or the claim is refused (ERR-RMA-0210).

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Screen SAL-SRL-16, menu Sales > Serial registration. Services: srl_reg, srl_get, srl_search.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Tab to the field SOLD DT and enter the dispatch date recorded on the carrier manifest. If left blank, Ledgerline fills this field automatically using the current system working date.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: The screen provides three operational action buttons: • srl_search: Calls the service SERIAL REGISTRATION LIST to display existing records matching partial search criteria. • srl_get: Calls the service SERIAL REGISTRATION GET to retrieve an existing record for enquiry or amendment. • srl_reg: Calls the service SERIAL REGISTRATION REG to write the new registration record into the sales ledger database.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: If entering a large batch of dispatches for a single bike shop, note that the field CUST CD retains its value between successive entries if you use the standard terminal reset key rather than closing screen SAL-SRL-16 entirely.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: Do not use the button srl_reg to amend an existing dispatch date or customer code. If a bicycle is returned by a retailer and subsequently re-allocated, refer to the goods inward procedures for credit handling before attempting any changes on screen SAL-SRL-16.

r7.quote: SAL-SRL-16 SERIAL REGISTRATION REG Menu: Sales > Serial registration. Roles: [SAL-EXEC, SAL-MGR, SYS-ADMIN].

r8.quote: Reg srl_reg Get F3 srl_get Search F2/Enter srl_search

r9.quote:
service: srl_get
title: SERIAL REGISTRATION GET
module: SAL
kind: read
screen: SAL-SRL-16

r10.quote:
service: srl_reg
title: SERIAL REGISTRATION REG
module: SAL
kind: write
screen: SAL-SRL-16

r11.quote: service: srl_search title: SERIAL REGISTRATION LIST module: SAL kind: read screen: SAL-SRL-16
